A1.justification: Both 11-page PDFs present the same DCE study, and all supplied pages support reliable textual and visual comparison. Both end with references; the appendix and supplementary material mentioned in the text are absent from both files.

before.justification: v1 reports original human evaluation of caption attributes and downstream LLaVA experiments, including benchmark and annotation-method comparisons in Tables 2-5.

after.justification: v2 retains the original human-evaluation and downstream experimental results in Tables 2-5.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same visual-specialist extraction, object and relation attributes, and LLM integration into region and image captions. The components and prompts are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same DCE-1M and COCO-derived DCE-118K data, instruction-tuning datasets, and VQA and multimodal evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 2-5 and the figures, including InternVL2 and LLaVA-NeXT captioners, human annotations where reported, and the same downstream LMM baselines.

E3.justification: Sections 3.4 and 4.1 retain identical sampling, model configurations, training procedures and evaluation settings. The 100-image attribute evaluation and benchmark metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: The attribute-richness analysis, annotation-method comparison in Section 4.3/Table 5, and aircraft and honey-jar case studies in Figure 6 are identical. No analysis is added or removed from the supplied PDFs.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run variability, confidence intervals or significance tests. The statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results and qualitative examples are identical. For example, Table 3 retains VQAv2 scores of 80.9 for LLaVA-v1.5(Ours) and 82.4 for LLaVA-NeXT*(Ours), under the same reported settings.

T1.justification: Neither version contains formal theoretical results or proofs. The attribute definitions and bounding-box/depth reasoning in Section 3 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims that visual specialists enrich captions and improve multimodal perception and reasoning. The claimed contributions and their scope are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations of object and relational information benefits are identical. Section 4.2 retains the same limitations concerning OCR thresholds, missing Chinese training data and detector noise.

D1.justification: Detection and NMS thresholds, model identifiers, captioning prompts and training disclosures are unchanged. Both retain the same promised code/data release and repository link; neither supplies the referenced supplementary implementation details.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 60 references are identical, including the positioning against DenseFusion and the claimed cost advantage of using open-source specialists and LLMs.

P1.justification: The author list changes 'Yuxiang Yao' to 'Yuxiang Zhao'. The arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 18 December 2024 to v2 dated 19 January 2025; the remaining wording and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-6 and Tables 1-5 retain identical content, formatting, captions and placement. Pages 2-11 render identically; the first-page edits do not alter the document's layout structure.

improvement.justification: The only differences are the author-name text and arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility information remain unchanged, supporting no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
